verdict.rationale: Ubuntu ships a full package archive (apt) and mentions IDE/AI-ML tooling support and WSL access, implying developers can install many packages, but there's no evidence of a single-command meta-install (e.g., a 'developer bundle' or snap/apt group install) that sets up a complete dev stack in one step. missing for 10: a documented single-command bootstrap (like a meta-package or setup script) installing IDEs/runtimes/toolchains together, and independent hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
